reason: DeepSee primarily orchestrates coding work across DeepSeek and vision providers, including configurable model routing, parallel task coordination, image understanding, and visual UI checks.

summaries.zh: DeepSee 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型路由、视觉理解和面向界面工作的视觉检查编排。
summaries.en: DeepSee orchestrates DeepSeek coding workflows with configurable model routing, image understanding, and visual checks for interface work.

capabilities: Routes coding tasks between configured AI models
Invokes vision providers and reusable local agent CLIs
Reads pasted images or image paths for visual analysis
Starts local previews and performs visual delivery checks
Stores and rotates configured provider API keys
